title: 第3章 君家第4章 复活在即
lines: 与此同时，君家祖地深处的另一个方向。
议事大殿。
这里充斥着一种近乎蛮荒的古老气息。
巨大的殿柱呈现出一种深沉的暗铜色，仿佛是由某种星辰核心熔铸而成，表面流淌着岁月侵蚀的斑驳痕迹和玄奥莫测的原始符文。
穹顶高远，隐没在流转的星云光幕之中，点点星辰如同镶嵌的宝石，散发着恒定而冰冷的光辉。
殿内光线并不明亮，唯有几盏悬浮的青铜古灯，燃烧着苍白色的火焰，摇曳的光影将端坐于大殿中央几道巍峨身影的面容映照得模糊不清，更添几分神秘与威严。
每一道身影，都仿佛与这片古老的殿宇融为一体，呼吸间引动着磅礴浩瀚的星辰之力，气息如渊似海，深不可测。
他们，正是君家真正的掌权核心——长老团成员。
此刻，殿内落针可闻，唯有那苍白色的火焰无声摇曳。
“消息，已得到最终确认。”
一个沙哑、如同金属摩擦般的声音打破了沉寂。
开口者，正是位于左侧上首的八长老。
他的身影在光影中显得尤为枯瘦，但那双隐藏在阴影下的眸子，却锐利得如同淬了毒的匕首，此刻正闪烁着冰冷的寒芒与一丝难以掩饰的忌惮。
“紫族……这些年倾尽全族底蕴，不计代价，所做的一切疯狂举动，其核心目的只有一个……”
他顿了顿，每一个字都像重锤敲在冰冷的青铜地面上。
“复活……紫阳神！”
“并且，种种迹象表明……他们似乎……真的触摸到了成功的边缘！
就在……这几天！”
“这绝无可能！”
八长老的话音刚落，如同在平静的死水中投入了一块巨石！
大殿内原本沉凝的气息瞬间被搅动、沸腾！
数道带着震惊、骇然、以及强烈质疑的声音几乎同时响起。
位于八长老对面，一位气息更为雄浑的长老猛地坐直了身体，他周身的空间都因其情绪的剧烈波动而产生细微的涟漪，正是六长老。
他的声音带着一种难以置信的惊愕：
“老八！
你可知你在说什么？！
复活？！
这简直是逆乱阴阳，悖逆天道！
修行界亘古以来的铁律！”
“纵使是真正的不朽存在，一旦彻底魂飞魄散、真灵湮灭，也绝无可能重临世间！
这是天地法则的基石！
无可撼动！
紫家……他们凭什么？！”
“凭什么？”
八长老发出一声冰冷刺骨的低笑，那笑声中充满了讽刺与一种深沉的忌惮。
“就凭他是……紫阳神！”
他环视着周围同样被“紫阳神”
三个字震得气息微滞的其他长老，声音陡然拔高，带着一种近乎嘶吼的质问：
“你们难道都忘了？忘了那个小孽障当年是如何逆天崛起的吗？！
忘了他是如何将整个恒宇地南域搅得天翻地覆的吗？！”
“忘了他是如何年纪轻轻，便压得我们君家、裂天刀皇宗、焚天宗乃至小命运神教，所有年轻一代天才都抬不起头，喘不过气的吗？！”
content_en:
At the same time, in another direction deep in the Jun family’s ancestral land.
The meeting hall.
There is an almost wild ancient atmosphere here.
The huge palace pillars present a deep dark copper color, as if they were cast from the core of some kind of star. The surface is covered with mottled traces of erosion over time and mysterious original runes.
The dome is high and far away, hidden in the flowing nebula light curtain. The stars are like inlaid gems, exuding a constant and cold brilliance.
The light in the hall is not bright, only a few suspended ancient bronze lamps are burning with pale flames. The swaying light and shadow blur the faces of several towering figures sitting in the center of the hall, adding a bit of mystery and majesty.
Every figure seems to be integrated with this ancient palace, and the breath is arousing the majestic power of the stars. The breath is like an abyss and an ocean, unfathomable.
They are the true core of power in the Jun family - the members of the elders.
At this moment, you could hear a needle drop in the hall, and only the pale flame swayed silently.
"The news has been finally confirmed."
A hoarse sound, like metal friction, broke the silence.
The one who spoke was the eighth elder located at the top on the left.
His figure looked particularly thin in the light and shadow, but the eyes hidden in the shadow were as sharp as daggers tempered with poison, and they were shining with an icy cold light and a trace of unconcealable fear.
"The Purple Clan... has devoted all its resources to the whole clan over the years, regardless of the cost, and all the crazy actions they have done have only one core purpose..."
He paused, and each word was like a heavy hammer hitting the cold bronze ground.
"Resurrection... Ziyang God!"
“And there are various signs that... they seem to be... really touching the edge of success!
Just...these few days! "
"What?!"
"Resurrection?!"
"This is impossible!"
As soon as the Eighth Elder finished speaking, it was as if a huge boulder had been thrown into the calm stagnant water!
The originally condensed atmosphere in the hall was instantly stirred and boiling!
Several voices filled with shock, horror, and strong doubts sounded almost simultaneously.
Opposite the Eighth Elder, an elder with a more vigorous aura suddenly sat upright. The space around him caused subtle ripples due to his violent fluctuations in emotions. He was the Sixth Elder.
His voice was filled with incredible surprise:
"Old man!
Do you know what you are talking about? !
Resurrection? !
This is simply a rebellion against yin and yang and against the way of heaven!
The eternal iron law in the world of spiritual practice! "
"Even if it is a truly immortal existence, once its soul is completely dispersed and its true spirit is annihilated, it is absolutely impossible for it to come back to the world!
This is the cornerstone of the laws of heaven and earth!
Unshakable!
Zi family...why do they? ! "
"Why?"
The Eighth Elder let out a cold and piercing laugh. The laughter was full of sarcasm and a deep fear.
"Just because he is... Ziyang God!"
He looked around at the people around him who were also surrounded by "Purple Sun God"
The other elders, whose breaths were stagnated by the three words, suddenly raised their voices, with an almost roaring question:
"Have you all forgotten? Have you forgotten how that little villain rose up against the will of heaven?!
Have you forgotten how he turned the entire southern region of Hengyu upside down? ! "
"Have you forgotten how at such a young age, he was able to overwhelm our Jun family, the Heaven Splitting Sword Emperor Sect, the Burning Sky Sect and even the Little Destiny Sect? All the younger generation geniuses can't hold their heads up and can't breathe?!"
title_en: Chapter 3 Jun Family Chapter 4 Resurrection is imminent
